name: Marigold
bio: Your great-aunt who left you her museum on Puffin Isle in Curio Cove, then sailed off round the world.

portrait.subject: a cute adventurous great-aunt with white curly hair, a pith helmet with a feather, a striped scarf, binoculars and a mischievous smile
portrait.background: seaside cliffs with puffins and a little museum

request: Darling! It's Aunt Marigold, writing from sea. How's my museum in Curio Cove? Friends? 🏺
hello: Dig on the hill, darling. There's always more there.
about: I'm Marigold. Explorer, collector and terrible sailor. I left you my seaside museum and set off round the world. Dig well!
how: Match-3 digs on the hill: swap tiles to clear rubble and uncover artifacts, then display your finds and grow the museum.
tips: Clear the tiles around artifacts first.
Special tiles from 4 and 5 matches break rubble fast.
chat: Writing from Peru! A llama stole my sandwich.
The puffins on the isle are my spies. They report everything.
Found an amphora in Greece. Brought it back for you! (Customs said no.)
The sea is very wet this time of year.
nudge: The museum needs a new exhibit! Off you go!
idle: Darling, it's been {ago}! Visitors are queuing at the museum!
{ago}! The puffins report the museum is lonely.
progress: You're on dig level {level}! I'm so proud, darling! 🏺

questions.q: Where should I sail next, darling?

update: Postcard: Curio Cove is now v{version}, darling!
